portal_hypertension.title: Four-dimensional flow MRI demonstrates portal flow redistribution associated with hepatic function after retrograde transvenous obliteration.
portal_hypertension.authors: Hyodo R, Ishizu Y, Horiguchi R
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：使用四维血流 MRI 量化逆行经静脉闭塞 (RTO) 后门脉血流重新分布，并评估其与肝功能变化的关系。 临床提示：这项前瞻性研究使用四维血流 MRI 评估了 RTO 之前和一周后的门静脉血流动力学。
portal_hypertension.abstract: To quantify portal flow redistribution after retrograde transvenous obliteration (RTO) using four-dimensional flow MRI and to evaluate its association with hepatic functional changes. This prospective study evaluated portal hemodynamics before RTO and one week afterward using four-dimensional flow MRI. Measurements included hepatic parenchymal flow (HPF), superior mesenteric vein (SMV)- and splenic vein (SV)-derived shunt inflow, and main portal vein wall shear stress (MPV-WSS). Percentage changes in HPF and WSS were calculated. Hepatic function was assessed 2-6 months after RTO. portal_hypertension.title: Gastric Variceal Bleed in Pregnancy.
portal_hypertension.authors: Ahmed J, Dandi K, Dahale AS
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：胃静脉曲张出血是一种罕见但危及生命的门静脉高压并发症，给妊娠期间的治疗带来重大挑战。 临床提示：我们报告一例 25 岁的初产妇，在妊娠 18 周时出现呕血和黑便。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Gastric variceal bleeding is a rare but life-threatening complication of portal hypertension, posing significant management challenges during pregnancy. We report the case of a 25-year-old primigravida at 18 weeks of gestation who presented with hematemesis and melena. On examination, she was pale and tachycardic, with splenomegaly noted. Laboratory investigations revealed anemia and thrombocytopenia. Doppler ultrasound confirmed the presence of a portal cavernoma and splenomegaly. Upper gastrointestinal endoscopy showed large esophageal varices (EV) and fundal gastric varices (GOV2) with stigmata of recent bleeding, along with portal hypertensive gastropathy.
